$comment: Four measures. Resist adding a fifth. Full definitions in docs/METRICS.md.

measures.label: the share
measures.help: This group as a percentage of the total for the same month.

guards.$comment: Below this, the share is suppressed and rendered as a greyed band. Stops early BEV percentages from looking like noise.

measures.label: the change on a year ago
measures.help: Compared with the same month last year. Avoids seasonal distortion.

measures.label: the 12-month running total
measures.formula: SUM(n) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
measures.help: Smooths out the March financial-year peak and rental fleet buying.

share_change_display.$comment: A move from 10% to 15% is +5pp, never +50%. Enforce this in the formatter, not per-chart.

derived_measures.$comment: Every derived measure a preset names must appear here, or the preset cannot be resolved. docs/METRICS.md holds the prose definition; this list is the vocabulary.
derived_measures.label: the combined share of the five largest
derived_measures.formula: SUM(n) OVER (top 5 dim_value by n in the month) / SUM(n) OVER (PARTITION BY month)
derived_measures.note: Membership is recomputed every month, so the line measures concentration rather than the fortunes of a fixed five.

derived_measures.label: the share still on the road
derived_measures.note: Of the vehicles first registered in cohort C, the share still registered at a later snapshot, against the first snapshot in which the cohort was observed. Computed from the archived aggregates in data/snapshots/, never by joining vehicles: the register carries no stable vehicle identity. Every figure states its base and its first observed snapshot.

derived_measures.label: the average age of the fleet
derived_measures.note: Report the median alongside the mean. The distribution has a long tail and the mean alone misleads.

derived_measures.label: registrations per 1,000 residents
derived_measures.note: Stats NZ subnational population estimates, a separate reference file with its own vintage. Label the estimate year on the chart.

derived_measures.label: the typical age of used imports
derived_measures.note: Used imports only. NZ-new age at registration is 0 by construction from 2007, so including NZ-new vehicles would restate the new/used mix, not measure age. vehicle_year is a year not a date, so this carries up to +/-1 year of granularity error. Never report to a decimal.

derived_measures.label: the used-import lag
derived_measures.note: Years between a model going on sale new in NZ and first appearing as a used import.

derived_measures.label: the average fuel consumption
derived_measures.note: Vehicles with a combustion engine only. Electric vehicles have no figure and are left out, not counted as zero. See docs/METRICS.md.
